sprint.field_display_name_note: Display name not observable via acli: `acli jira workitem view --json` returns names:null and acli exposes no field-list command. Field identified by its content (array of sprint objects) on GIM-85 and by the create payload accepted on GIM-159. JQL name is `sprint` (verified with JQL `project = GIM AND sprint = 378`).
sprint.create_value_shape: bare integer sprint id at additionalAttributes.customfield_10020
sprint.read_back_shape: array of objects {id, name, state, boardId, startDate, endDate, goal}

set_on_create.command: acli jira workitem create --from-json <payload with additionalAttributes.customfield_10020 = 378> --json
set_on_create.observed: GIM-159 created with customfield_10020 = [{ id: 378, name: "GIM Sprint 8", state: "active", boardId: 9 }]

set_on_edit.evidence: `acli jira workitem edit --generate-json` emits keys assignee, description, issues, labelsToAdd, labelsToRemove, summary, type - no additionalAttributes. Neither create nor edit has a --sprint flag. Sprint assignment must happen in the create --from-json payload.

current_sprint.strategy: acli jira board list-sprints --id 9 --state active --json; require exactly one sprint with state=active
current_sprint.note: Board 9 returned exactly one active sprint. If a board ever returns zero or multiple active sprints, --current-sprint must fail and require an explicit sprint = <id> filter via --jql rather than pick one.

constraints: acli workitem create has no --sprint flag; sprint is settable only through additionalAttributes in --from-json (verified on GIM-159).
acli workitem edit --generate-json has no additionalAttributes; sprint cannot be changed after creation through acli (verified from the generated template).
acli jira sprint list-workitems requires both --board and --sprint; it cannot resolve the current sprint on its own.
acli jira sprint view requires --id; there is no current/newest shortcut.
acli has no field-list command; custom field display names are not observable (workitem view JSON returns names:null).

A payload assignee of null overrides a CLI --assignee argument: GIM-159 was created with assignee null, then assigned with `acli jira workitem assign --key GIM-159 --assignee '@me' --yes --json` (exit 0).
The transition flag is --status; there is no --to flag (verified in `acli jira workitem transition --help`).
